name: Woody's Diner
tagline: Classic 50s surf-themed diner serving hearty all-day breakfasts, burgers, and shakes
description: A quintessential Southern California surf-and-chrome diner decked out in wood-paneled surfboards, classic rock-and-roll memorabilia, and cozy booth seating. Woody's serves generous portions of all-day comfort food: hearty breakfast skillets, fluffy buttermilk pancakes, the famous 'Big Cruiser' burger, hand-spun milkshakes and malts, and nightly dinner specials.
historicNote: Capturing the mid-century 1950s Southern California car and surf culture along Chapman Avenue, a long-time family favorite for locals and Chapman University students.

specials.title: Monday Homestyle Pasta Night
specials.description: Spaghetti & meatballs, meat lasagna, or chicken fettuccine alfredo served with garlic cheese toast and choice of soup or dinner salad for $13.99.

specials.title: Woody's Taco Tuesday
specials.description: $3.50 Crispy or Soft Tacos (seasoned beef, chicken, or carnitas) and $4.50 ice-cold draft beers starting at 4:00 PM.

specials.title: Kids Eat Free Wednesday
specials.description: One free kids meal from the Little Surfer Menu with the purchase of any regular-priced adult entree after 4:00 PM.

specials.title: Burger & Shake Thursday
specials.description: Famous Woody's 1/3 lb Cheeseburger with seasoned fries + hand-scooped chocolate, vanilla, or strawberry shake combo for $15.

specials.title: Friday Fish & Chips & Clam Chowder
specials.description: Golden beer-battered Alaskan cod fillets with crispy fries, coleslaw, and homemade New England clam chowder bread bowls.

specials.title: Weekend Surfer Breakfast & Prime Rib
specials.description: Morning breakfast skillets & Belgian waffles with warm syrup, followed by Slow-Roasted Prime Rib dinner after 4:00 PM.

specials.title: Sunday Family Pasta & Sundae Special
specials.description: Pasta Night feature starting at 4:00 PM, plus 50% off classic hot fudge sundaes and banana splits.

events.title: Classic Car & Hot Rod Sunday Meet
events.description: Vintage surf wagons, woody wagons, and classic hot rods gathering in the parking lot with diner breakfast favorites.
